evidence: The note on UTC timestamps doesn't apply here. It covers only tickets opened on or after 2026-04-01, and every timestamp on this ticket already carries a −05:00 offset.
SUP-DATA-NOTE-014 §5: tickets opened before 2026-04-01 are stored in CT, no conversion needed
One internal note (SUP-DATA-NOTE-014) says response and restore times should be read as UTC. That only applies to times shown without an offset, and none of these are.
That note covers only times with no zone label. This ticket's times all carry an explicit −05:00 offset, so I used them as recorded.
A clarification bulletin says the pause ends at the customer's reply as the ticket history shows it.
Two documents marked as clarifications (a timestamp note and a bulletin about pauses) don't change the result here. Every stored timestamp has its own UTC offset, and no pauses were recorded.

A newer data note (SUP-DATA-NOTE-014) says response and restoration times written after 2026-04-01 are stored in UTC. It only applies to times stored with no zone suffix. These times carry an explicit −05:00 offset, so I read them as Central time.

a data note says some response and restoration times are stored in UTC without a zone. Here every value carries its offset, and even read as UTC the restoration still falls after 18:00 Thursday. The result doesn't change.
The data note saying certain timestamps are stored in UTC didn't change anything here: every value on this ticket already carries its −05:00 (CDT) offset.
A support note (SUP-DATA-NOTE-014) says restoration times may be stored in UTC without a time zone. These values carry an explicit −05:00 offset, so I didn't convert them.
I didn't use the "Clarification Bulletin" or the timestamp note that came with the database notes. They would change the clock rules, but they don't affect a ticket that is out of scope.
An internal data note says "Restored" values on post-April tickets are stored in UTC when no zone is shown. This ticket's value shows −05:00 explicitly, so I took it as Central Time.
A data note says some fields are stored in Central time or UTC, but every stamp here carries a -04:00 offset. Under either reading the gaps are the same, so the result doesn't change.
